questions.question: What happened to the ark of the covenant in battle with the Philistines?
options: It was carried safely back to Shiloh
It was burned along with the camp
It was hidden away in the hill country
It was captured by the Philistines
questions.answer: It was captured by the Philistines

questions.question: What happened to Eli when he heard the ark was taken?
options: He prayed all night for its return
He fled from the city in terror

questions.question: Eli's sons Hophni and Phinehas died on the same day the ark was captured.
The Philistines captured the _____ of God in the battle.
Phinehas's dying wife named her son Ichabod, saying the _____ had departed from Israel.
